name: Deliciosísimo
overview: Deliciosísimo is a bizarre cooking web series and sitcom created by Martín Garabal (along with Alexis Moyano) for FWTV, which aired between 2017 and 2018. It features Garabal cooking absurd recipes, often centered around sausages, in a humorous and ironic style, alongside an animated sausage named Salchi
